title: GPL ENGAGES CONTRACTORS ON ONGOING INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL), represented by Mr. Kesh Na...
text:
GPL ENGAGES CONTRACTORS ON ONGOING INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS
 Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL), represented by Mr. Kesh Nandlall, Head of GPL’s Executive Management Committee; Mr. Bharat Harjohn, Deputy Chief Executive Officer; and Mr. Ryan Ross, Director, along with Mr. Alfonso De Armas, Director General of the Ministry of Public Utilities and Aviation, held a meeting with representatives of Kalpataru Projects International Limited (KPIL), China National Machinery Import & Export Corporation (CMC), PowerChina International Group Limited, CEP, and FixIt IEH to discuss the progress of ongoing electricity infrastructure projects.
 The meeting provided an opportunity to review project developments, address key matters and strengthen coordination among stakeholders to support the timely and effective execution of these critical projects.
 GPL remains committed to advancing infrastructure development to strengthen Guyana’s electricity network and support the growing demand for reliable electricity supply.

UPDATE – SERVICE RESTORATION IN PROGRESS (EAST BANK DEMERARA)
 Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL) wishes to advise that electricity supply has been restored to customers from Garden of Eden to Sarah Johanna.
 Customers from Sarah Johanna to Timehri and Long Creek remain affected following the earlier distribution feeder going offline.
 GPL’s technical teams continue to work to restore electricity supply to all remaining affected customers as quickly and safely as possible.
 GPL apologises for the continued inconvenience and thanks customers for their patience and understanding.

title: Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL) is upgrading 20,000 customers in Georgetown to smart meters as part of efforts to mode...
text:
Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL) is upgrading 20,000 customers in Georgetown to smart meters as part of efforts to modernise the electricity network and improve service delivery.
 The new meters will provide automatic readings and support faster restoration efforts. The meter, base and installation will be provided at no cost to customers.
 More information, including installation schedules and other important details, will be shared shortly.
 Customers are encouraged to follow GPL’s official social media platforms for updates on when installations will commence in their communities.

title: SERVICE INTERRUPTION ADVISORY Dear Customers, Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL) wishes to advise customers in Section A...
text:
SERVICE INTERRUPTION ADVISORY
 Dear Customers,
 Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL) wishes to advise customers in Section A Grove and Diamond, Coverden New Scheme, Grove, Farm, and Herstelling New Scheme that they are currently experiencing a service interruption due to damage to the electricity network caused by a vehicular accident along the Mocha Access Road.
 GPL's technical teams are en route to the location to assess the damage and undertake the necessary corrective works to restore electricity supply as quickly and safely as possible.
 An investigation has also commenced to identify and locate the driver and vehicle involved in the incident.
 GPL sincerely apologises for the inconvenience caused and thanks customers for their patience and understanding. Further updates will be provided as more information becomes available.
